SELECT COUNT(*) as 'Total Tests' FROM results

SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(createdat) as time_sec,
  download as value,
  'Download' as metric
FROM results
WHERE $__timeFilter(createdat)
ORDER BY createdat

SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(createdat) as time_sec,
  upload as value,
  'Upload' as metric
FROM results
WHERE $__timeFilter(createdat)
ORDER BY createdat

SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(createdat) as time_sec,
  latency as value,
  'Ping' as metric
FROM results
WHERE $__timeFilter(createdat)
ORDER BY createdat

SELECT 
  HOUR(createdat) as 'Time',
  ROUND(AVG(download), 2) as 'Medium Download',
  ROUND(AVG(upload), 2) as 'Medium Upload',
  ROUND(AVG(latency), 2) as 'Average Ping',
  externalip as 'External IP',
  COUNT(*) as 'Tests'
FROM results
WHERE $__timeFilter(createdat)
GROUP BY HOUR(createdat)
ORDER BY HOUR(createdat)

panels.title: Statistics by Hour of the Day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(createdat, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00')) as time_sec,
  AVG(download) as value,
  'Medium Download' as metric
FROM results
WHERE $__timeFilter(createdat)
GROUP BY HOUR(createdat), DATE(createdat)
ORDER BY time_sec

SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(createdat, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00')) as time_sec,
  AVG(upload) as value,
  'Medium Upload' as metric
FROM results
WHERE $__timeFilter(createdat)
GROUP BY HOUR(createdat), DATE(createdat)
ORDER BY time_sec

panels.title: Average Speed by Hour of the Day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  AVG(download) as 'Average Day'
FROM results
WHERE HOUR(createdat) >= 6 AND HOUR(createdat) < 18
  AND $__timeFilter(createdat)

SELECT 
  AVG(download) as 'Average Night'
FROM results
WHERE (HOUR(createdat) < 6 OR HOUR(createdat) >= 18)
  AND $__timeFilter(createdat)

SELECT 
  AVG(download) AS 'Current Monthly Average Download'
FROM results
WHERE 
  YEAR(createdat) = YEAR(CURDATE())
  AND MONTH(createdat) = MONTH(CURDATE())
  AND $__timeFilter(createdat);

SELECT 
  AVG(upload) AS 'Current Monthly Average Upload'
FROM results
WHERE 
  YEAR(createdat) = YEAR(CURDATE())
  AND MONTH(createdat) = MONTH(CURDATE())
  AND $__timeFilter(createdat);

SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(createdat) as time_sec,
  download as value,
  'Day (6h-18h)' as metric
FROM results
WHERE $__timeFilter(createdat)
  AND HOUR(createdat) >= 6 
  AND HOUR(createdat) < 18
ORDER BY createdat

SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(createdat) as time_sec,
  download as value,
  'Night (18h-6h)' as metric
FROM results
WHERE $__timeFilter(createdat)
  AND (HOUR(createdat) < 6 OR HOUR(createdat) >= 18)
ORDER BY createdat

SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(createdat) as time_sec,
  latency as value,
  'Ping Variation' as metric
FROM results
WHERE $__timeFilter(createdat)
ORDER BY createdat

SELECT
  DATE_FORMAT(createdat, '%Y-%m') AS Month,
  COUNT(*) AS 'Total Tests',
  SUM(CASE WHEN download < 800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 'Download Failures',
  SUM(CASE WHEN upload < 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 'Upload Failures',
  SUM(CASE WHEN latency > 40 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 'Ping Failures',
  ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN download < 800 OR upload < 400 OR latency > 40 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS 'Failure Percentage'
FROM results
WHERE 
  YEAR(createdat) = YEAR(CURDATE())
  AND $__timeFilter(createdat)
GROUP BY Month
ORDER BY Month;

SELECT 
  createdat as 'Date/Time',
  ROUND(download, 2) as 'Download',
  ROUND(upload, 2) as 'Upload',
  ROUND(latency, 2) as 'Latency',
  CASE 
    WHEN download < 400 THEN '⚠️ Download Low'
    WHEN upload < 200 THEN '⚠️ Low Upload'
    WHEN latency > 40 THEN '⚠️ High Latency'
    ELSE '✅ Normal'
  END as 'Alert'
FROM results
WHERE $__timeFilter(createdat)
  AND (download < 400 OR upload < 200 OR latency > 30)
ORDER BY createdat DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT 
    DATE_FORMAT(createdat, '%Y %M') AS Month,
    AVG(download) AS `Average Download`,
    AVG(upload) AS `Average Upload`,
    AVG(latency) AS `Average Latency`,
    CASE 
        WHEN AVG(download) < 800 THEN '⚠️ Download Low'
        WHEN AVG(upload) < 200 THEN '⚠️ Upload Low'
        WHEN AVG(latency) > 40 THEN '⚠️ High Latency'
        ELSE '✅ Normal'
    END AS Alert
FROM results
WHERE YEAR(createdat) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE())
GROUP BY YEAR(createdat), MONTH(createdat), DATE_FORMAT(createdat, '%Y %M')
ORDER BY YEAR(createdat), MONTH(createdat);
